messages:
sam: kicking off split rollout for llm-route v3 under flag `ff.llmroute.v3` — plan: 0% -> 3% over 10m, cohorts: canary(us-west), staged(eu). deploy-bot: rollout started id=rb-3580 (link: https://releases/internal/rb-3580)

olivia: ack. jen — confirm concurrency caps on v3?
jen: set per-node concurrency cap to 8, global inflight limiter to 200.

tina: pin applied for eu-stage to v2 for 20m: `deploy-bot pin-cohort --cohort=eu-stage --service=llm-route --version=v2 --ttl=20m`
deploy-bot: pin created (pin-9002)

erin: dashboards configured: p50/p95 latency, error_rate, queue_depth. alerts: p95>1800ms or errors>0.8%

olivia: small bump in 503s from canary at 10:06 UTC — 0.2% -> 0.7% in 4m, mostly requests hitting seq_len>900.
sam: pausing ramp. deploy-bot: pause rb-3580 (reason: 503 spike).

tina: looking at traces — KV cache miss storms on v3 when seq crosses 1k boundary, looks like a hot path regression in buffer handling.

erin: proposal: drain canary workers and shift traffic back to v2 for canary cohort; keep eu-stage pin. quick rollback for canary only?
sam: do it. deploy-bot: rollback canary subset for rb-3580 -> v2 (partial rollback)
deploy-bot: partial rollback complete — canary reverted to v2, staged pin remains (pin-9002).

jen: removing global canary pin. tina: removed. leaving cohort pin until root cause fixed.
olivia: filing ISSUE-2009 with traces and repro steps. initial hunch: quantized kernel fallback slower for long sequences.
erin: adding release-note blurb on ticket: "v3 canary paused; partial rollback for canary due to KV-cache regression on long sequences; eu-stage pinned; investigating."
sam: follow-ups: tina to open perf bug, jen to schedule constrained re-run (1% with seq<=512) after fix, olivia to coordinate customer comms if needed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: updated ticket https://issues/internal/ISSUE-2009 (status: investigating)
olivia: will re-open ramp once a validated patch is in and smoke tests pass.
erin: closing thread — tracking in ISSUE-2009.
